text: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Near all sign with keys a large quantum computer could crack. Every account that has ever signed has already shown its public key. Magen adds a quantum safe lock, and puts every chain behind it.
Here it is on iPhone.
Get a new wallet. Pick a name. Twelve words back it up, and they stay hidden.
The same twelve words make your Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Zcash addresses, plus an M L D S A sixty five quantum safe key.
One transaction upgrades the account. Approve it.
Your wallet, live on Near testnet, with two locks on every move.
Receive on any chain, each with its own Q R code.
Send half a Near. The approval shows everything, and it is signed twice: classical and quantum safe.
On the explorer the signer key is the quantum safe one. And here is the receiver, magen noam, holding the money.
Swap one Near for U S D T on Ref Finance. Four calls, one approval, two signatures.
One point two four U S D T arrived, and the explorer shows Ref paying it to the wallet.
Bridge out to any chain Omni Bridge lists live: Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana and more. Same approval, same two signatures.
Seconds later it lands on Base, at this wallet's own address. Then Solana: the receiving account holds the wrapped Near.
Now Ethereum, from Near. Near's chain signatures sign for your Ethereum address, but only after your wallet checks both locks.
Signed on Near, then mined on Sepolia. Etherscan shows the payment from your M P C address, and the receiver's balance.
Now the attack. The same request with only the classical key. Near refuses it on chain, so the signer never signs.
Private send pays a one time account only the receiver can open. Here it is on the explorer, holding the funds.
Two of three guardians can recover the wallet, and none of them can ever spend.
And the Q Day switch. One transaction makes your quantum safe key a native Near key. Near now lists an M L D S A sixty five key on the account.
Activity keeps every move, each one linked to the explorer.
And Magen locks itself behind Face I D.
Every chain. Two locks. One phone. That's Magen.
